name: Goodwill
expression: Consideration − Fair value of identifiable net assets
meaning: A source-defined long-term-asset measurement or disclosure-analysis relationship.
intuition: Connects recognition, carrying amount, impairment, disposal, or asset-age disclosures to reported performance.
workedExample: See the corresponding worked example in the LM7 lesson.
commonMistake: Ignoring framework differences, non-depreciable land, mixed asset populations, or mechanical ratio effects.
relatedLearningOutcome: compare the financial reporting of the following types of intangible assets: purchased, internally developed, and acquired in a business combination
